reviewMethod: Opened the final rendered PNG previews at original resolution.

assets.visualObservation: Six raised steel stiffeners break up the broad gray-green caisson face; teal flotation cells sit below and bright cleats cap the deck. The preview reads as a drydock gate module.

Two upright cylinder bodies sit on the trolley plate; yellow retaining bands, black wheels, a silver pull handle and visible valve caps separate the components. The preview reads as a gas-cylinder trolley.
A broad brown bin tapers to its lower discharge neck; the pale slatted screen deck and gray fork supports remain visible. The preview reads as a grit-recovery hopper.
